scene: Midsummer, and the convoy from Emporion has made the Lakydon: thirty hulls low in the water with Iberian silver, tin and salt fish. The Ephors have tallied the harbour dues, and by old custom the Council takes its tenth before the rest goes to the treasury.

choices.label: Take your share of the dues
choices.resultText: Fifty drachmae of Emporion silver, counted out on the quay. The rest goes to the treasury, as custom holds.

scene: The snow is off the passes and the first rafts of the year have come down the Rhodanos to Arelate, stacked with northern tin and Gaulish hides. The Ephors have tallied the river tolls, and by old custom the Council takes its tenth before the rest goes to the treasury.

choices.label: Take your share of the tolls
choices.resultText: Fifty drachmae in river tolls, weighed out at the Arelate customs house. The rest goes to the treasury, as custom holds.

scene: Heralds in the agora: Massalia goes to the vote. The city chooses two Archons and two Ephors, one seat of each for the Palaioi and one for the Dynatoi. Candidacies are open now and close when Winter opens; the vote runs the season through, and the winners take office in Spring. A seat in the chamber is needed to stand; every citizen may vote.

choices.label: Noted
choices.resultText: The heralds move on down the quay. Candidacies and the ballot are under Politics, on the Oligarchy Council tab.

scene: The Three Hundred take up the quay fees this season. Tonight a Chian wine shipper is in your courtyard with a purse of a hundred drachmae and a quiet request: that your voice be absent when the fees are read. His slave waits at the gate, where the street can see him.

choices.label: Take the purse and say nothing (100 drachmae, −5 prestige)
choices.resultText: The purse is heavy and the street is dark. Somebody at the gate counted the slave's steps all the same.

choices.label: Send him and his purse back through the gate, in sight of the street (+10 prestige)
choices.resultText: He goes without a word. By morning the quay knows which door would not open.
